Question 13
?

The region enclosed by the curve y=x3, the vertical line x=−1 and the horizontal lines y=0 and y=1 is rotated 2π radians about the line x=−1, as shown above. Which of the following integrals gives the volume of the resulting solid?

a
π∫−10(2y1/3+1)dy
b
π∫01(y2/3+2y1/3+1)dy
c
π∫−11(−y2/3+2y1/3)dy
d
π∫01(y2/3+2y1/3)dy
e
π∫−10(y2/3+1)dy
Submit
